prose: The Sonic Portal Architect Admiral Hitzz has been sending festie-folk and wide-eyed wooks into aetheric audio dimensions using magical gongs for many years. Tonight we'll explore the alchemy of vibration and the psychedelic spaceship that requires no intake substances to fuel its astral journeys. Returning Vibe Ranter Owen Hunt (Bootsy Greenwood) will also be in the mix!
